Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner improperly reframed the comparison to an edge-case (polar per-location) where sunrise happens only once per year, then concluded full moons are more frequent. The question expects a general/global frequency comparison, under which sunrise (daily) clearly occurs more often than full moons (~monthly), equinoxes (twice yearly), or solar eclipses (few per year). This faulty framing led directly to the incorrect final answer.
